fusions.name: Ringing Knock
fusions.desc: Knocks your brow against the target's armour for 5 damage, leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gatebreaker
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 6 tiles onto the target and rams it for 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from the full 6 tiles. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Layered Brace
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and raises your armour by 10%, both for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Ram's Barding
fusions.desc: Conjures spiked barding: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it, and your maximum health rises by 8.
